name: @intent-wallet/settlement
description: Universal Settlement Engine — the settlement orchestration layer (the Stripe of Web3). Drives an approved ExecutionPlan through a deterministic, resumable, idempotent pipeline (pre-flight → quote-lock → gas → execute → confirm → cross-chain settle → reconcile → notify) to its financial outcome, or safely reports why not. The mandatory front door to execution: it never owns funds and never holds keys.
